newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay shr-index falls 1.9 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Bombay shr-index falls 1.9 pct in late trade.

text.p: The 30-share index of the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) fell 64.86 points or 1.9 percent to 3349.15 points in late trade on Thursday, traders said.
They said punters were hammering prices of pivotals including State Bank of India, Reliance, TISCO and ITC.
"Yesterday the operators took the market up and now we're back to square one," said a trader at foreign fund.

The benchmark index jumped 66.64 points to 3414.01 on Wednesday as Calcutta operators covered short positions on the last day of the account. The rise was aided by a technical correction after last week's five percent fall.
